content.playerFantasy: A lone survivor in a decaying, claustrophobic world, haunted by a forgotten past and battling relentless threats.
content.coreFun: Survive and Threat while utilizing its own world, visual identity, progression, economy, content, and interaction design.
coreLoop: Enter a dangerous area with limited information, identify the current threat, and search for a route, key item, resource, or safe checkpoint.
Avoid, outplay, or temporarily resist the threat while managing resources and cooperating with nearby players when teamwork is available.
Reach a checkpoint or escape condition, convert survival progress into unlocks or knowledge, and attempt a harder segment with new threat patterns.

signatureSystems.name: ROBLOX_SURVIVAL_HORROR_ESCAPE

A sense of mystery and discovery.  A growing sense of dread and isolation.  A system of rewards that are based on player actions and risk.

content.progressionDirection: The game will gradually introduce new challenges and content, encouraging players to explore and adapt to the evolving threat.  A system of branching paths and rewards will reward players for taking risks and experimenting with different strategies.  The game will evolve its difficulty based on player performance.
content.visualDirection: A stylized, slightly unsettling aesthetic.  Dark, muted colors, atmospheric lighting, and detailed environmental design.  Emphasis on visual storytelling and creating a sense of dread.  A focus on creating a believable and immersive world.
content.mobileUx: The game will be designed with mobile play in mind, with a focus on touch-screen controls and responsive gameplay.  The game will be playable on a wide range of mobile devices.  The game will be optimized for a variety of screen sizes.  The game will be optimized for a variety of mobile devices.  The game will be playable on a variety of mobile devices.
content.marketTargetDirection: Global, with a focus on younger audiences (16-24 years old) who enjoy survival horror and escape games.
